currentText: Provide your current-year income statement and confirm any change of employer.
proposedText: Provide your current-year income statement and confirm any change of employer. Include allowances, bonuses, commissions and any other payment type indicator amounts at question 2 if shown on your income statement.
quote: Declare at this question income from salary or wages where tax was withheld, this includes: - salary and wages - commissions - bonuses - money from part-time or casual work - parental leave pay - amounts for lost salary or wages paid under - an income protection policy - a sickness or accident insurance policy - a workers compensation scheme - foreign employment
rationale: Current wording only asks for income statement and employer change. Passage requires declaration of all salary or wages components including allowances, bonuses, commissions and other payment types at question 1 or 2, which the current text omits.
